purpose: Let a founder find their industry, see the AI services we package for it, open the four industry pages, and start an AI check-up.

seo.title: AI packages by industry | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Ready-made AI packages for finance and accounting, healthcare and clinics, online stores and retail, home services and seven more industries, built and run by an embedded team in the Philippines.

sections.job: Say what the industry packages give a founder (a head start) and offer the one committing action.

content.heading: A head start for your industry.
content.lead: We package popular AI services for common industries. Find yours, start with one service and add more over time.
body: Built and run by our team in the Philippines, as part of yours.

images.source: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, nearly square (about 1:1), safe to crop to 4:5 around the centre. On a low, calm faceted paper hill, four small bundles of flat faceted paper plants stand in a loose row, each a different kind: a sheaf of slender leaves, a branch of soft blossoms, a cluster of broad leaves and a tuft of tall grasses, in Partner Navy, slate blue and pale blue facets. One continuous satin ribbon in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan enters from the lower left, loops once around the stem of each bundle and runs out at the right edge: ready-made packages for different industries, tied together by one team. Keep the bundles in the middle and lower two thirds and the top third a calm, open Daylight sky. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.
images.placement: right half of the hero split (1.08fr text | 1fr image); on mobile under the actions, above the meta line
images.textArea: none (text sits beside the image); keep the top third calm
images.alt: Four different bundles of faceted paper plants, each tied by the same satin ribbon.

content.heading: Find your industry.
content.lead: Each of these has its own page: the slow work the package takes off your team, what’s in it, and how your data stays safe.

items.title: Finance and accounting
items.text: Less typing at month end: invoices read, expenses checked and the monthly report drafted for your team to approve.
items.meta: Invoice processing · Bookkeeping help · Expense checks · Monthly reports

items.title: Healthcare and clinics
items.text: Calls answered, reminders sent, intake forms filled in before the visit and notes drafted for the doctor to check.
items.meta: AI receptionists · Appointment reminders · Patient intake · Note-taking during visits

items.title: Online stores and retail
items.text: Content for your whole catalog, a shopping assistant, recommendations and support that answers at any hour.
items.meta: Product content · Shopping assistants · Recommendations · Customer support

items.title: Home services and local businesses
items.text: Calls answered and jobs booked while you’re out on a job, with a message for you when a caller needs a person.

sections.name: Section · More industries
sections.job: List the other seven Brand DNA industry packages, which have no page yet, and route anyone else to the AI check-up or Contact.
sections.desktop: Section head, then a two-column table (Industry 400 in Body/Strong | Popular AI solutions), then a link to Contact.
sections.mobile: Head; one hairline row per industry (Heading/4 industry above Body/SM solutions); link.

content.heading: More industries we package.
content.lead: Each of these is available now. If yours isn’t listed, the AI check-up starts from how your business works.

rows: Contract review, legal research, document drafting, client intake
Lead follow-up, listing descriptions, virtual staging
Quality checks, predictive maintenance, demand forecasting, route planning

sections.name: Section · Data
sections.job: Say that regulated industries start with a privacy and compliance review, and list the data promises that apply to every package.
sections.desktop: Whole Partner Navy chapter. Section head (Heading/1 title with the cyan accent 0.9fr | Body/LG lead 1.1fr). A 2x2 grid of promises between hairlines: cyan UI icon (24) | Heading/4 title (the law item carries Source key 1) and Body/Default text. Cyan underlined link, then the numbered source list.
sections.mobile: Head stacked; the four promises as one column of hairline rows (icon | title and text); link; source list.

content.heading: Your data rules come first.
content.lead: Projects in healthcare, finance, insurance and legal start with a privacy and compliance review, because those industries have stricter rules about data.

items.title: Your data stays where you decide
items.text: In your own systems wherever possible. We never use it to train anything you don’t own.

items.title: A person checks the work
items.text: A person reviews every piece of work before it reaches you.

items.title: An owner and a backup plan
items.text: Every automation has both, written down clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

items.title: Protected by law
items.text: Personal data in the Philippines is protected by the Data Privacy Act of 2012, enforced by an independent National Privacy Commission.

sources.text: Republic Act No. 10173, Data Privacy Act of 2012. Supreme Court E-Library. Retrieved 2026-11-02.
